articles.title: Engaged Capital Announces Intention to Nominate Highly Qualified Director Candidates to BlackLine, Inc.’s Board
articles.mainIdea: Engaged Capital Announces Intention to Nominate Highly Qualified Director Candidates to BlackLine, Inc.’s Board
articles.summary: Business Wire: Engaged Capital Announces Intention to Nominate Highly Qualified Director Candidates to BlackLine, Inc.’s Board. NEWPORT BEACH, Calif., January 13, 2026--Engaged Capital, LLC ("Engaged Capital"), an investment firm specializing in enhancing the value of small- and mid-cap North American companies, today announced its intention to nominate a slate of highly qualified director candidates to the BlackLine, Inc. (NASDAQ: BL) ("BlackLine" or the "Company") Board of Directors (the "Board") in connection with the Company’s 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders (the "Annual Meeting"). Related tickers mentioned: BL.
